title: ProtVista feature record
description: The canonical payload the generic bring-your-own-data adapters (features-csv, features-tsv, features-json, bed) emit and the feature tracks consume. Generic format only — domain-adapter (EBI API) payloads are not schematised. See docs/adapter-reference.md.

type.description: Feature category label (e.g. DOMAIN, BINDING). Drives `filter:` and colour grouping.

start.$comment: features-json also accepts `begin` as an alias for `start`; `start` wins when both are present.

description.description: Free text shown in the default tooltip. Omitted when empty.

score.description: Optional numeric score. Omitted when empty.
